purpose: Analyze vehicle driving energy intensity, lifetime driving aggregates, observed drive trends, speed relationships and temperature relationships.
primaryGoal: Understand measured consumption and its relationship to driving conditions while distinguishing lifetime summary evidence from the selected-range observed drive sample.

dataSources.name: Lifetime driving summary
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-enabled query; driving-stats vehicle key; AbortSignal forwarded; retry false. Lifetime labeling is explicit in EfficiencyEvidenceBrief, not independently verified against backend aggregate implementation.
dataSources.units: DrivingStats frontend contract retains km, km/h, Wh/km, seconds, Wh, kilograms and a 0-1 regen ratio. Model converts summary quantities for display. Backend JSON and numerical semantics were not inspected and must not be inferred to be canonical SI solely from the page.
dataSources.trust: inspectStats guards object shape, marks missing/nonfinite fields partial; useDataState receives historical provenance.

dataSources.name: Observed drive history
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-enabled query; AbortSignal forwarded; FAST stale time; safeArray selection. Page sends no start/end/limit/offset. Hook documentation says API default is 50 rows; backend default not independently inspected. Workspace dates filter only returned rows.
dataSources.units: Drive frontend fields are meters, Wh, m/s and Celsius. Display conversion occurs in model; cache values are not rewritten.
dataSources.trust: inspectDrives keeps object rows, marks missing measurements partial, and independently selects eligible observations per series.

dataSources.name: Workspace scope and presentation preferences
dataSources.behavior: Consumes shell vehicle/range ownership; no competing page pickers. SavedViewMenu applies query state on /efficiency. Hook internals and persistence runtime are unverified.

components.name: PageLayout / CardGrid
components.inspection: Page call sites only; no global layout audit.

components.name: EfficiencyChart
components.behavior: Forwards children through props into ChartCard; exportable and toolbar default true; responsive chart height derives from allocated placement. Shared toolbar implementations not inspected.

duplicatedPatterns.pattern: Four charts already share one source-aware canonical chart-frame adapter.
duplicatedPatterns.decision: Reuse EfficiencyChart and shared ChartCard; do not add another chart-state or toolbar engine.

duplicatedPatterns.pattern: Summary metrics deliberately recur in KPI and energy-insight contexts.
duplicatedPatterns.decision: Keep eight KPI and six insight occurrences; shared metric derivation already exists. Repeated CO2/distance/top-speed/cost are preserved content, not deletion candidates.

duplicatedPatterns.pattern: Source-state notices and errors are repeated across source-dependent sections.
duplicatedPatterns.decision: Existing domain adapters separate chart and non-chart rendering. No evidence from this single page warrants a new global source-state composite.

sourceEvidence: Page uses min-w-0 sections and three CardGrid placements with third/half sizes: EfficiencyPage.tsx:83-115.
Saved-view action wraps with responsive gaps: EfficiencyPage.tsx:76-77.
EfficiencyChart.tsx:22-23,31-33 derives both chart heights from allocated placement policy; plots use ResponsiveContainer.

EfficiencyTemperatureTable.tsx:57-64 specifies range/count/intensity mobile summary with hidden reciprocal-economy/distance/speed roles. Comment states the existing details modal retains all columns; shared modal behavior was not inspected.

issues.detail: Three of six values are hidden from the mobile summary. Preservation depends on the shared all-column details path; source comment is not proof of mounted reachability.
issues.fix: Exercise existing row details at narrow widths and ensure reciprocal economy, distance and average speed remain reachable; reuse DataTable, not a parallel mobile table.

sourceEvidence: All four chart occurrences provide localized ariaLabel and explicit dataColumns: EfficiencyTrend.tsx:15-21; EfficiencySpeedDistribution.tsx:16-22; EfficiencyScatter.tsx:18-27.
Six-column table uses DataTable and role typography rather than raw HTML controls: EfficiencyTemperatureTable.tsx:38-64.
Retry callbacks are wired in EfficiencySource.tsx:22,28,34,39 and EfficiencyChart.tsx:34.

issues.detail: Axis labels use explicit 9px/10px sizes; speed distribution repeats this at lines 27-28 and scatters use 10px at lines 35-37. Small labels are a readability risk, not a measured contrast or accessibility failure.
issues.fix: Use existing chart typography policy and verify long localized labels, 200% text, accessible data tables and small allocated widths.

accessibility.reducedMotion: FadeIn is reused; actual reduced-motion and chart animation behavior unverified.

states.initialLoading: Queries feed PageLayout; each domain source has skeleton/loading handling without hiding section shells.
states.empty: Temperature table and distribution test zero eligible rows; trend requires three observations; scatters require four. KPI source includes ActionableEmptyState analytics.efficiency.
states.error: Per-source fatal and malformed states use ErrorDisplay or ChartCard error props with retry; no page-wide data conditional.
states.partial: Finite measurement inspections mark missing fields/invalid rows partial; partial warnings keep available observations.
states.staleAndRefresh: StaleRefreshWarning receives DataState; OperationalBrief receives retained when stale or refreshError is present.
states.offline: Delegated to existing DataState and shared frames; no independent offline simulation or source inspection of that infrastructure.
states.unknown: Missing finite stats and absent observations use null or em dash, not fabricated zero measurements.
states.disabled: Both driving queries disabled without a vehicle; source empty/unknown paths exist but mounted no-vehicle UX unverified.

issues.detail: safeArray converts null and non-array payloads to []; page inspectDrives therefore cannot distinguish malformed response from resolved empty history despite its malformed presentation branch.
issues.fix: Provide validated source-envelope evidence through the existing driving data owner without mutating raw query data or breaking existing list consumers; distinguish malformed, unavailable and actual empty.

issues.detail: One or two valid trend points are marked empty; EfficiencyScatter.tsx:28 similarly marks one to three observations empty. Tables receive data props, but whether below-threshold observations remain accessible depends on shared frame behavior.
issues.fix: Preserve exact thresholds unless separately authorized; verify insufficient-sample messaging and accessible/exportable underlying observations rather than dropping sparse data.
issues.confidence: high for thresholds; access behavior unknown

visualIssues.detail: Local efficiency ramp hardcodes fluorescent green #39ff14 and neon cyan #00f0ff. Overview independently hardcodes cyan/emerald/purple/amber bars at lines 37,42,47,52; trend hardcodes cyan gradient/stroke at lines 27,33; scatters hardcode amber/purple at line 39. These are source-confirmed neon/saturation inputs, not a rendered visual verdict.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse restrained existing palette/semantic color ownership while retaining meaningful intensity thresholds, series distinctions and explicitly saved chart palette preferences. Do not create a new color engine.

architectureIssues.detail: Workspace range is read at line 37 but never sent to useDrives. Model filters only the fetched default page, while query key omits range. Older/custom ranges can be empty or incomplete despite available backend history. Lifetime stats are explicitly independent and must not be silently range-filtered.
architectureIssues.fix: Pass both instants into an existing typed bounded driving-history contract and obtain all required observations through the existing data owner; describe sample scope honestly. Preserve vehicle scope, lifetime summary, query cancellation and date semantics.

architectureIssues.detail: efficiencyColor expects Wh/km thresholds, but speedDist.avgEff is already converted into display Wh/mi or Wh/km in model.ts:141-145. Changing distance preference can change a bucket's semantic color for the same measurements.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain an unrounded source intensity for classification and convert only its displayed measurement; preserve thresholds and the exported efficiencyColor helper identity.

architectureIssues.detail: Missing or invalid drive dates are admitted even when a workspace range is selected. Partial inspection warns about dates, but selected-period series may include unknown-date observations.
architectureIssues.fix: Make unknown-date inclusion explicit in source scope and preserve existing behavior until a source-owner decision defines ranged eligibility; do not silently delete rows during cosmetic modernization.

architectureIssues.detail: Estimated cost/km uses fixed 0.12 multiplied by Wh/km divided by 1000, while EfficiencyEvidenceBrief.tsx:46 supplies literal '$' currency preferences. No tariff/settings source is visible in this derivation.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve current estimate and both occurrences; disclose the assumption through existing context/help, and have the data/settings owner verify currency/tariff semantics before any business-calculation change.

architectureIssues.detail: Overview and temperature table import LayoutCard from layout/layout-reference; EfficiencyChart imports policy/context there. Reviewed contract exposes LayoutCard from the category barrel; internal policy exports must not be guessed.
architectureIssues.fix: Adopt existing category export for LayoutCard; retain concrete policy/context imports until an existing public API is confirmed. No speculative barrel change.

priority.reason: Existing component decomposition and source-state preservation are strong, but workspace sample completeness, malformed-versus-empty classification, unit-invariant color classification and fluorescent palette inputs require scoped follow-up.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Driving history scope and envelope integration

inputs: bounded limit and pagination as needed
preserve: existing consumer keys/defaults unless explicitly versioned

dependsOn: existing /drives endpoint bound/pagination semantics; backend implementation unverified
requiredSharedChanges.detail: Coordinate with the existing driving data owner. Do not introduce a second query engine, modify every driving consumer, or claim the default page is a complete range.

competingImplementations.pattern: Feature-local chart color policy alongside shared palette ownership
competingImplementations.decision: Reuse existing palette/settings policy; keep domain intensity thresholds local and separate from display conversion. No shared palette edit is established as necessary.

competingImplementations.pattern: Chart, summary, table and source-state architecture
competingImplementations.decision: Already delegates to ChartCard, OperationalBrief, DataTable and existing feedback primitives. No new ModernCard, table controller, stats renderer or date/vehicle picker warranted by this audit.

preservation.lineCountScope: Page plus 12 consumed production dependency files listed in filesRead; excludes barrel, tests, unmounted EfficiencyStats and fixtures. No historic baseline comparison was performed.

sections.name: Key metrics
sections.content: Eight KPI occurrences; lifetime evidence scope/provenance; efficiency/rated_range/phantom_drain glossary strip.

sections.name: Overview and trend
sections.content: Overview gauge plus four bars; annotated daily area trend with date/intensity/distance data columns.

sections.name: Speed and temperature analysis
sections.content: Speed distribution and two separate scatter plots; retain all three identities.

sections.name: Breakdown and insights
sections.content: Six-column temperature table and six energy-insight occurrences.

actions: Saved view apply and existing SavedViewMenu capabilities through route/currentQuery/onApply; menu internals unverified.
PageLayout dataSources for summary and drive history; preserve shared source/recovery actions.
Four charts retain exportable=true, toolbar=true, ariaLabel and dataColumns contracts; actual toolbar actions unverified.
Daily trend annotation identity efficiency-daily-trend, scope efficiency, selected vehicle.
Temperature DataTable compact pagination, stable tableId, mobile summaries and complete-row details contract.
GlossaryTerm interactions and ActionableEmptyState guidance analytics.efficiency.
Header-owned vehicle and date range; no duplicated local scope controls.
dataBehavior: No source/cache mutation; Drive SI values remain meters/Wh/m/s/Celsius, summary legacy frontend units remain explicit pending backend verification.
Lifetime stats independent of range-filtered observations, with existing period captions.
Energy intensity eligibility: distance at least 1000 meters and finite positive consumed energy; zero/missing energy is not zero intensity.
Current half-open range filtering and existing unknown-date admission; fix scope through integration rather than accidental deletion.
Trend uses newest 30 eligible returned drives reversed, per-drive date labels rather than a synthesized daily aggregate; threshold three observations.
Separate speed/temperature scatters round display coordinates/intensity; threshold four observations.
Speed bucket boundaries 0-30,30-60,60-90,90-120,120+ use selected display-speed units; unweighted mean contributing-drive intensity.
Temperature buckets use Celsius boundaries 0,10,20,30 regardless of displayed F/C labels; keep count, mean intensity, total distance and unknown mean speed when any speed is missing.
Summary regen ratio multiplies 0-1 by 100; energy insight retains Wh source with display conversion.
Reciprocal economy, CO2 estimate and fixed-assumption cost remain specialist measurements, not replacement generic fake values.
Keep null/em dash, partial warnings, retained-data behavior, malformed errors and section shells.

evidenceLimits.method: Read-only mounted-page source audit and directly relevant dependency slices; no browser or application server invoked.
evidenceLimits.backend: Only /drives and /drives/stats registration inspected; SQL, bound handling, returned JSON units, defaults and aggregate scope unverified.
evidenceLimits.sharedInternals: Global layout, ChartCard, DataTable details/export, saved-view persistence, DataState internals, authentication, catalogs and shell not audited.
evidenceLimits.noiseScope: Scoped page regex found zero inline styles, raw forbidden controls, direct chart/map/motion imports, white/neon text or glow classes. Consumed domain presenters contain fluorescent hex inputs. No explicit glow/pure-white decoration was identified in inspected domain source; composed shared visuals remain unknown.
